# Subresource Integrity (SRI) Checker & Hash Generator

> Free tool: generate a sha384 integrity= hash for any script or stylesheet, or run a CLI that checks a page's cross-origin tags for a missing integrity attribute, a missing crossorigin attribute, or a hash that no longer matches what the CDN serves. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
